en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with paths, lawns, and a circular fountain with a high water jet at the center. The foreground shows neatly arranged garden beds and trees; in the background are red-roofed buildings and a larger, elegant house or small palace rising above the townscape. The sky is clear blue. At the top in red Gothic-style letters it says "Radeburg." on the left and "Promenade mit Springbrunnen." on the right.
